set.body: Spec 8.1 item 1. The sketch hides branches with >50% of points in free space 4-connected to the border of rasterize(x): 99 of 195 on house1, but it also drops open object parts (walkway; trunk edge stops 5 px short of crown). Either a documented package classifier or the UI does not filter.
set.title: Decide whether the package classifies open-background MAT branches
